sources.label: Wikipedia, "HAT-P-3b"
sources.quote: HAT-P-3b, also named Teberda, is an extrasolar planet that orbits the star HAT-P-3 approximately 450 light-years away in the constellation of Ursa Major.

introduction.text: It is the only planet known around HAT-P-3. Its orbit and size follow Stassun et al. 2017's fit, the archive's default.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "HAT-P-3b"
sources.quote: It was discovered by the HATNet Project via the transit method and confirmed with Doppler spectroscopy, so both its mass and radius are known quite precisely.
